about.p1: Hi, I'm Kazu — a graphic designer passionate about creating expressive visuals and strong visual identities.
about.p2: I explore composition, typography, color, and imagery to turn ideas into impactful visual experiences — from esports posters and collage layouts to cinematic digital art.
